subject: Carr Park Phase 2 Design Funding
overview: The committee approved $294,131.50 in linkage funds to advance the design phase of Carr Park Phase 2 while federal and state grants remain pending. The committee also discussed administrative cleanup of older linkage accounts and tabled the approval of previous meeting minutes.

items.title: Carr Park Phase 2 Design and Permitting
items.summary: Approved an amended request of $294,131.50 for design, permitting, and community outreach for Carr Park Phase 2. Alicia Hunt explained that these funds allow work to start immediately while the city waits for larger federal and state grants to become available in January.

items.title: Meeting Minutes
items.summary: Tabled the approval of minutes from the meeting held on October 27, 2022.
